requirement: The system shall allow players to create and join multiplayer game rooms and keep each room's player count updated.

The system shall provide soft real-time 3D gameplay through a Three.js browser client and an Erlang/OTP game server, with a separate web server supplying static game assets. Browser clients shall initiate multiplayer connections using WebSocket over HTTP, and communication shall support concurrent, asynchronous exchanges.

The client shall maintain the game-server list supplied by the server. When redirected, it shall update that list and close the current connection; when notified of a server error, it shall reload the game page.

While connected, the client shall send heartbeat requests every 60 seconds and accept responses without changing gameplay state. After a connection closes, it shall attempt to reconnect and, when prior session information is available, identify the existing room, player, and ship. On receiving the server's reconnection response, it shall restore the corresponding ship to the scene and continue gameplay.
The system shall support deploying a separate replica game server alongside the master server for fault-tolerant operation.
